Most prominent are three large, near-circular annuli located in the upper-mid section with approximately closed-loop geometry.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, irregular low-intensity pixel clusters (dark spots) occurring primarily in the gaps between macro-annuli. These clusters lack internal gradients and are most concentrated along the lower flank and posterior transition zone.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of three primary macro-annuli in the central dorsal-lateral region form a large, scalene triangle. A second, smaller cluster of high-intensity blobs forms a linear arrangement running parallel to the horizontal axis of the animal's lower flank.
